newsitem.title: USA: AM Intl says acquisitor gets financing.
newsitem.headline: AM Intl says acquisitor gets financing.

text.p: AM International Inc said Tuesday the corporation formed by affiliates of Paceholder Associates Inc to acquire all the common shares of AM has obtained a financing commitment in connection with the proposed transaction.
The financing, from Provident Bank, is subject to conditions, including maintenance of certain liquidity levels.
Under terms of the proposed transaction, the current shareholders of AM International would receive $5 per common share and AM International would become a wholly owned subsidiary of the purchaser.
AM shareholders are to vote on the transaction at a meeting tentatively scheduled for January 1997.
The company manufactures printing equipment and supplies.
